title: How closely the currents follow geostrophic balance
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how closely the monthly-mean currents follow geostrophic and thermal-wind balance: where, at which depths and in which seasons the flow departs from it, how large the departures are compared with the flow itself, and what causes them. Show how much the result depends on the way you compute the gradients and on the fields ending at 1000 m. Winds are not supplied.
